# Introduction
This script handles the data visualization for the outputs generated in the `1DP_02_astro_subset` R Markdown file.

```{r}
suppressMessages(library("Matrix"))
suppressMessages(library("DropletUtils"))
suppressMessages(library("ggplot2"))
suppressMessages(library("Seurat"))
suppressMessages(library("SeuratObject"))
suppressMessages(library("clustree"))
suppressMessages(library("DoubletFinder"))
suppressMessages(library("scProportionTest"))
suppressMessages(library("gridExtra"))
suppressMessages(library("dittoSeq"))
suppressMessages(library("dplyr"))
suppressMessages(library("SoupX"))
suppressMessages(library("ComplexHeatmap"))
suppressMessages(library("ggridges"))
suppressMessages(library("SeuratWrappers"))
suppressMessages(library("openxlsx"))
suppressMessages(library("EnhancedVolcano"))
suppressMessages(library("ggrepel"))
suppressMessages(library("clusterProfiler"))
suppressMessages(library("enrichplot"))
suppressMessages(library("AnnotationDbi"))
suppressMessages(library("org.Mm.eg.db"))
suppressMessages(library("glmGamPoi"))
suppressMessages(library("future"))
suppressMessages(library("patchwork"))

plots <- list()
col_list <- list()
orders <- list()
source("code/0F_01_colours_orders.R", local = F, echo = F, print.eval = F)
source("code/0F_02_general_functions.R", local = F, echo = F, print.eval = F)
source("code/0F_03_label_names.R", local = F, echo = F, print.eval = F)
gene_symbol <- read.table("data/all_genes.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
```


Create folders for saving objects
```{r Folders, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define folders
folders <- c("results", "results/06_technical_parameters")

# Create folders if they don't exist
lapply(folders, function(f) if (!dir.exists(f)) dir.create(f, recursive = TRUE))
```


#Violin plots for astro cells 
```{r}
seurat_object <- readRDS("ws/02_astro_subset/1DP_02_seurat_annotated_astro.rds")

meta_data <- seurat_object@meta.data

# Generate plots without condition faceting
p1 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "nFeature_RNA", get_label("nFeature_RNA")) + 
  scale_y_log10(labels = add_sci_superscript) +
  violin_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

p2 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "nCount_RNA", get_label("nCount_RNA")) + 
  scale_y_log10(labels = add_sci_superscript) +
  violin_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

p3 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "percent.mt", get_label("percent.mt")) + 
  violin_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

p4 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "percent.rib", get_label("percent.rib")) + 
  violin_theme

# Combine vertically using patchwork
library(patchwork)
plots[["violin"]] <- p1 / p2 / p3 / p4
plots[["violin"]]

ggsave(
  filename = "results/06_technical_parameters/2V_06_violinplot_astro_isol_astro.tiff",             
  plot = plots[["violin"]],         
  device = "tiff",                          
  width = 5,                              
  height = 11,                              
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 600,            
  compression = "lzw",  
  bg = "white" 
)
```

```{r}

# Calculate medians grouped by Isolation protocol and Condition
median_by_isolation <- meta_data %>%

    Cell_Count         = n(), # Optional: shows how many cells are in this group
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View the results
print(median_by_isolation)
```

#QC at the sample level
```{r}
meta_data <- seurat_object@meta.data

# Generate plots with your specific faceting and theme
# Use facet_grid(. ~ Condition) to put conditions side-by-side
p1 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "nFeature_RNA", get_label("nFeature_RNA")) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ Condition, drop = TRUE) + 
  scale_y_log10(labels = add_sci_superscript) +
  violin_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

p2 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "nCount_RNA", get_label("nCount_RNA")) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ Condition, drop = TRUE) + 
  scale_y_log10(labels = add_sci_superscript) +
  violin_theme +
  theme(strip.text = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

p3 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "percent.mt", get_label("percent.mt")) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ Condition, drop = TRUE) + 
  violin_theme +
  theme(strip.text = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

p4 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "percent.rib", get_label("percent.rib")) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ Condition, drop = TRUE) + 
  violin_theme +
  theme(strip.text = element_blank())

# Combine using grid.arrange
plots[["violin"]] <- p1 / p2 / p3 / p4
plots[["violin"]]

ggsave(
  filename = "results/06_technical_parameters/2V_06_violinplot_astro_isol_astro_per_sample.tiff",             
  plot = plots[["violin"]],         
  device = "tiff",                          
  width = 10,                              
  height = 11,                              
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 600,            
  compression = "lzw",  
  bg = "white" 
)
```

```{r}
# Calculate medians grouped by Condition and Isolation protocol to match the faceted plot
median_by_condition_isolation <- meta_data %>%
  group_by(Condition, Isolation_pub) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_nFeature    = median(nFeature_RNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_nCount      = median(nCount_RNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_percent_mt  = median(percent.mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_percent_rib = median(percent.rib, na.rm = TRUE),
    Cell_Count         = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View the results
print(as.data.frame(median_by_condition_isolation))
```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. COMPUTE PER-CONDITION METRICS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A. Doublet removal rates (from the pre-filtering DoubletFinder checkpoint)
df_meta <- seurat_df@meta.data
if (!"Isolation_pub" %in% colnames(df_meta)) {
  df_meta <- df_meta %>% mutate(Isolation_pub = factor(case_when(
    Isolation == "Aggressive" ~ "WorthMech",
    Isolation == "Gentle"     ~ "WorthGentle",
    Isolation == "Miltenyi"   ~ "Miltenyi"
  )))
}

doublet_stats <- df_meta %>%
  group_by(Condition, Isolation_pub) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells_Pre_DF = n(),
    High_Conf_Doublets = sum(Doublet == "Doublet - High Confidence", na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_Doublets_Removed = (High_Conf_Doublets / Total_Cells_Pre_DF) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# B. Filtered Cell Yield and Astrocyte Purity (from all annotated cells)
all_meta <- seurat_all@meta.data

purity_stats <- all_meta %>%
  group_by(Condition, Isolation_pub) %>%
  summarise(
    Cell_Yield = n(),
    Astrocyte_Count = sum(seurat_annotated == "Ast", na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_Astrocyte_Purity = (Astrocyte_Count / Cell_Yield) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge into a single summary table
sample_bar_data <- left_join(doublet_stats, purity_stats, by = c("Condition", "Isolation_pub"))

# Ensure Condition and Isolation_pub factor levels match your global project orders
sample_bar_data$Condition <- factor(sample_bar_data$Condition, levels = orders[["samples"]])
sample_bar_data$Isolation_pub <- factor(sample_bar_data$Isolation_pub, levels = orders[["Isolation_pub"]])

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. GENERATE FACETED BAR PLOTS (Order: 1. Yield, 2. Doublets, 3. Purity)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Border color fallback if not defined in col_list
border_col <- if(!is.null(col_list[["borders"]])) col_list[["borders"]] else "black"

# Panel 1: Filtered Cell Yield
b1 <- ggplot(sample_bar_data, aes(x = Isolation_pub, y = Cell_Yield, fill = Isolation_pub)) +
  geom_col(color = border_col, linewidth = 0.25, width = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Condition, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_list[["isol_prot"]]) +
  labs(y = "Total cell yield", x = "Isolation") +
  theme_mk + remove_grid + violin_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  )

# Panel 2: Doublets Removed (%)
b2 <- ggplot(sample_bar_data, aes(x = Isolation_pub, y = Pct_Doublets_Removed, fill = Isolation_pub)) +
  geom_col(color = border_col, linewidth = 0.25, width = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Condition, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_list[["isol_prot"]]) +
  labs(y = "Doublets removed (%)", x = "Isolation") +
  theme_mk + remove_grid + violin_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  )

# Panel 3: Astrocyte Purity (%) - bottom plot with angled x-axis labels
b3 <- ggplot(sample_bar_data, aes(x = Isolation_pub, y = Pct_Astrocyte_Purity, fill = Isolation_pub)) +
  geom_col(color = border_col, linewidth = 0.25, width = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Condition, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_list[["isol_prot"]]) +
  labs(y = "Astrocyte purity (%)", x = "Isolation") +
  theme_mk + remove_grid + violin_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 310, vjust = 0.1, hjust = 0.2)
  )

# Combine vertically using patchwork
plots[["barplots_technical"]] <- b1 / b2 / b3
plots[["barplots_technical"]]

# Save matching your tiff resolution and sizing
ggsave(
  filename = "results/06_technical_parameters/2V_06_barplot_astro_qc_per_condition.tiff",
  plot = plots[["barplots_technical"]],
  device = "tiff",
  width = 7,
  height = 11,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg = "white"
)

```

```{r}

```

#Fitlering of cells
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# AUDIT SCRIPT: CELL RETENTION & FILTERING TRACKER ACROSS ALL SAMPLES
# ==============================================================================
suppressMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
})

cat("Loading pipeline checkpoint RDS objects...\n")

# 1. Load objects
s_raw <- readRDS("data/seurat_Isolation_only.rds")
s_df  <- readRDS("ws/01_all_cells/01_seurat_doubletFinder_ACSA2_all_cells.rds")
s_annotated_all <- readRDS("ws/01_all_cells/1DP_01_seurat_annotated_all_cells.rds")
s_astro <- readRDS("ws/02_astro_subset/1DP_02_seurat_annotated_astro.rds")

# Determine sample column name safely across objects
sample_col <- if ("sample" %in% colnames(s_raw@meta.data)) "sample" else "SampleName"

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 1: EXTRACT BARCODES & MAP TO PUBLICATION PROTOCOL NAMES
# ==============================================================================

# Checkpoint 1: Initial barcodes loaded into Seurat
df_step1 <- s_raw@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, Raw_Sample = !!sym(sample_col))

# If "Isolation_pub" exists in s_annotated_all, transfer the publication name:
if ("Isolation_pub" %in% colnames(s_annotated_all@meta.data)) {
  pub_lookup <- s_annotated_all@meta.data %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "barcode") %>%
    dplyr::select(barcode, Protocol = Isolation_pub)
  
  df_step1 <- df_step1 %>%
    left_join(pub_lookup, by = "barcode")
}

# Standardize names to publication nomenclature (Condition + Publication Protocol)
# Aggressive -> WorthMech, Gentle -> WorthGentle, Miltenyi -> Miltenyi
df_step1 <- df_step1 %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = case_when(
      # If Protocol column was mapped from Isolation_pub, combine condition & protocol:
      !is.na(Protocol) & str_detect(Raw_Sample, "^(Ctrl|MCAO|Tau)") ~ 
        paste0(str_extract(Raw_Sample, "^[A-Za-z]+"), "_", Protocol),
      # Direct replacement of internal names to Isol_pub convention:
      str_detect(Raw_Sample, "Aggressive") ~ str_replace(Raw_Sample, "Aggressive", "WorthMech"),
      str_detect(Raw_Sample, "Gentle")     ~ str_replace(Raw_Sample, "Gentle", "WorthGentle"),
      str_detect(Raw_Sample, "Miltenyi")   ~ str_replace(Raw_Sample, "Miltenyi", "Miltenyi"),
      TRUE ~ Raw_Sample
    ),
    Step1_Initial_Loaded = 1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, Sample, Step1_Initial_Loaded)

# Checkpoint 2: Survived basic QC
df_step2 <- s_df@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, Doublet_Status = Doublet) %>%
  mutate(Step2_Passed_Basic_QC = 1)

# Checkpoint 3: Survived DoubletFinder
df_step3 <- s_annotated_all@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, Cell_Type = seurat_annotated) %>%
  mutate(Step3_Passed_DoubletFinder = 1)

# Checkpoint 4: Astrocytes (broad cluster 'Ast')
barcodes_ast_all <- s_annotated_all@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "barcode") %>%
  filter(seurat_annotated == "Ast") %>%
  pull(barcode)

# Checkpoint 5: Astrocytes retained after Aldh1l1 > 0 filtering
barcodes_ast_aldh1l1 <- rownames(s_astro@meta.data)

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 2: BUILD MASTER CELL-TRACKING TABLE
# ==============================================================================
master_cells <- df_step1 %>%
  left_join(df_step2, by = "barcode") %>%
  left_join(df_step3, by = "barcode") %>%
  mutate(
    Step2_Passed_Basic_QC = replace_na(Step2_Passed_Basic_QC, 0),
    Step3_Passed_DoubletFinder = replace_na(Step3_Passed_DoubletFinder, 0),
    Step4_Ast_Cluster = as.integer(barcode %in% barcodes_ast_all),
    Step5_Ast_Aldh1l1_Positive = as.integer(barcode %in% barcodes_ast_aldh1l1),
    Exclusion_Stage = case_when(
      Step2_Passed_Basic_QC == 0 ~ "Removed: Basic QC (percent.mt >= 20 | nFeature <= 500)",
      Step3_Passed_DoubletFinder == 0 ~ "Removed: DoubletFinder (Doublet - High Confidence)",
      Step4_Ast_Cluster == 0 ~ "Retained in non-astrocyte cluster",
      Step5_Ast_Aldh1l1_Positive == 0 ~ "Removed: Astrocyte Aldh1l1-negative",
      TRUE ~ "Retained: Aldh1l1+ Astrocyte"
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 3: AGGREGATE SUMMARY TABLE PER BIOLOGICAL SAMPLE
# ==============================================================================
# Define publication display order
order_levels <- c(
  "Ctrl_Miltenyi", "Ctrl_WorthGentle", "Ctrl_WorthMech",
  "MCAO_Miltenyi", "MCAO_WorthGentle", "MCAO_WorthMech",
  "Tau_Miltenyi", "Tau_WorthGentle", "Tau_WorthMech"
)

filtering_summary_per_sample <- master_cells %>%
  mutate(Sample = factor(Sample, levels = order_levels)) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    `1. Input Barcodes (Post-Parse/emptyDrops)` = n(),
    `2. Excluded: Basic QC (mt >= 20% or nFeature <= 500)` = sum(Step2_Passed_Basic_QC == 0),
    `3. Passed Basic QC` = sum(Step2_Passed_Basic_QC == 1),
    `4. Excluded: High-Confidence Doublets` = sum(Step2_Passed_Basic_QC == 1 & Step3_Passed_DoubletFinder == 0),
    `5. Retained Singlets (All Cells)` = sum(Step3_Passed_DoubletFinder == 1),
    `6. Annotated as Astrocytes (Ast)` = sum(Step4_Ast_Cluster == 1),
    `7. Excluded: Astrocytes Aldh1l1 == 0` = sum(Step4_Ast_Cluster == 1 & Step5_Ast_Aldh1l1_Positive == 0),
    `8. Final Retained Astrocytes (Aldh1l1+)` = sum(Step5_Ast_Aldh1l1_Positive == 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample)

# Add Total Row across all samples
total_row <- filtering_summary_per_sample %>%
  summarise(
    Sample = "Total",
    across(where(is.numeric), sum)
  )

filtering_summary_final <- bind_rows(filtering_summary_per_sample, total_row)

print("--- SUMMARY TABLE OF FILTERED CELLS ---")
print(as.data.frame(filtering_summary_final))

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 4: EXPORT TO CSV
# ==============================================================================
dir.create("results/supplements", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  filtering_summary_final,
  file = "results/supplements/2V_06_Filtering_Summary_per_Sample.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nSummary table successfully written to: results/supplements/2V_06_Filtering_Summary_per_Sample.csv\n")
```
